description: This is a test source file written in Kotlin for the Android platform, containing unit tests for the DeviceHandler class in the app. The tests validate various device info, status, permissions, and health reporting functionalities.

classes.name: DeviceHandlerTest
classes.description: A test suite for DeviceHandler, validating device info, status, permissions, and health data functionalities via multiple unit tests.

methods.name: handleDeviceInfo_returnsStablePayload
methods.description: Tests that the handleDeviceInfo method returns a stable payload with expected device info.

methods.name: handleDeviceStatus_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Validates the shape and contents of the device status payload.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Checks that the device permissions payload contains expected permission states.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsSendOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Ensures partial SMS send permission is interpreted as granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsReadOnlyPartialGrantAsGranted
methods.description: Ensures partial SMS read permission is interpreted as granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsNoSmsGrantAsDenied
methods.description: Checks that no SMS permissions are interpreted as denied.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsDisabledSmsAsDenied
methods.description: Verifies that disabled SMS feature results in denying SMS permissions.

methods.name: smsTopLevelStatusTreatsMissingTelephonyAsDenied
methods.description: Validates that missing telephony feature results in denied SMS capabilities.

methods.name: smsTopLevelPromptableStaysTrueUntilBothSmsPermissionsAreGranted
methods.description: Ensures promptability remains true until both SMS permissions are granted.

methods.name: smsTopLevelPromptableIsFalseWhenSmsCannotExist
methods.description: Checks promptability is false when SMS can't exist due to feature or permission issues.

methods.name: handleDevicePermissions_marksCallLogUnpromptableWhenFeatureDisabled
methods.description: Verifies call log permission is marked unpromptable when the feature is disabled.

methods.name: handleDeviceHealth_returnsExpectedShape
methods.description: Validates the shape and contents of the device health report payload.

methods.name: appContext
methods.description: Provides the mock application context for testing.

methods.name: parsePayload
methods.description: Parses JSON payload string into a JsonObject for validation.
